note: The control for the red one, and the direction the ruling was explicit about: wake on SUCCESS -> FAILURE ONLY. Red to green is good news and still not an interruption — a recovery resolves what already woke somebody, and waking a second session to say the problem is over turns every red into two. The event is EMITTED and printed; `wake_worthy` drops it, so this run ends on the idle bound rather than on the event. Without this fixture the red one would pass against a build that woke on every trunk transition, which is the noisy failure this family is one careless line away from.
